description:
Find US hospitals and community health centers near a zip code, or in a city and state, with each one's financial assistance (charity care) income limits.
Use it when a person asks whether they can get free or discounted care at a US hospital or health center, needs help with a hospital bill, or asks how to apply for hospital financial assistance.
Use it first when the patient names a place, not a specific hospital, or to get the facility id the other tools need.
Takes a zip code, or a city and state.
Returns name, address, phone, ownership, distance, data tier, and income limits as a percent of the poverty level for each facility. It does not say whether a household is eligible; check_eligibility does.

city.description: City name. Use with state when there is no zip.

kind.description: hospital, health_center (community health centers with sliding fees), or any.

radius_miles.description: Search radius around the zip, in miles.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example "MA".

zip.description: Five-digit zip code. Use this or city + state.

name: find_facilities
title: Find hospitals and health centers
